name: octaweave_create_board
description: Create a kanban board. Omit `columns` for the usual three (To do / Doing / Done); pass an empty array for a board with no columns.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

columns.description: Column names to seed. Omit for the default three; [] for none.
